name: MultiFunPlayer
summary: The gold-standard open-source multi-axis motion player driving OSR2, SR6, Handy & Buttplug devices cleanly from DeoVR, HereSphere & Plex.
ranking_rationale: Unlocks full 6-DOF pitch/roll/twist multi-axis trajectories natively on OSR2/SR6 rigs (trade-off: Windows desktop app designed around advanced DIY/multi-axis tinkerers).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Unlocks full 6-DOF pitch/roll/twist multi-axis trajectories natively on OSR2/SR6 rigs
Zero-latency sync hooks into Plex, MPV, VLC, DeoVR & HereSphere out of the box
Active community presets & smart speed smoothing
cons: Windows desktop app designed around advanced DIY/multi-axis tinkerers
Rich node config overwhelms casual phone-app users
